Attached: 1 image

An auditor's actual question is rarely "what's your process." It's closer to "show me every image running in production last Tuesday."

Anchore Enterprise generates a point-in-time inventory report for any date within retention, and can block already-running workloads that fail policy via Kubernetes Admission Controller.

Full quickstart on the blog https://anchore.com/blog/your-kubernetes-cluster-is-running-images-your-registry-scan-never-checked/

#Kubernetes #ComplianceOps #DevSecOps
